physical_model: Five unchanged P02 1:100 tiles plus P03 B3 fireplace
camera_assumption: Orthographic +Z normal to model floor, viewing direction -Z, +Y at top
visibility: Upward full-height opaque wall tops selected; wall sides deliberately dark
animation_coordinates: Actual connected cap boundary paths and physical arclength in model millimetres, independent of UV chart boundaries
mask_antialiasing: 4x4 coverage, sum adjacent triangle subpixel coverage
atlas_padding: 4 pixels copied into empty chart gutter, veto full excluded pixel-square union
atlas_sampling: Nearest; uncropped; full common atlas on all parts
source_save_policy: Read-only original receiver; isolated copy only
